attributes.name: Hunga Munga
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength skill + 1d6. You may additionally discard this card to add your Ranged skill.

If you are proficient with weapons, on your combat check, if you played another weapon, discard this card to add your Strength or Melee skill.
